title: int:Actor
description: Any natural person or legal entity participating in the INTELLIGENT platform. Subclass of cim:OrganisationRole. Replaces the former Member class as the canonical identity entity.

actorId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:actorId. UUID v4.

name.description: Legal name of the person or organisation. IRI: cim:name.

legalEntity.description: Legal entity name if different from name. IRI: int:legalEntity.

taxId.description: Tax identification number. GDPR-sensitive. IRI: int:taxId.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth for NaturalPerson. GDPR-sensitive. IRI: int:dateOfBirth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

ownershipPercentage.description: Share of ownership in a company (0-100). IRI: int:ownershipPercentage.

nationality.description: Nationality of NaturalPerson actors. IRI: int:nationality.

isBeneficialOwner.description: True if actor ultimately owns or controls a legal entity. IRI: int:isBeneficialOwner.

isControlPerson.description: True if actor exercises significant authority over a legal entity. IRI: int:isControlPerson.

residentialAddressId.description: FK to residential Address. IRI: int:residentialAddressId. UUID v4.

billingAddressId.description: FK to billing Address. IRI: int:billingAddressId. UUID v4.

businessAddressId.description: FK to business/registered Address. IRI: int:businessAddressId. UUID v4.

contactDetailIds.description: FKs to ContactDetails records. IRI: int:contactDetailIds. UUID v4 array.

communityId.description: FK to Community this member belongs to. IRI: int:communityId. UUID v4.

validFrom.description: Start of membership validity. IRI: int:validFrom. ISO 8601 with timezone.

validUntil.description: End of membership validity. NULL if indefinitely active. IRI: int:validUntil.

isActive.description: Whether membership is currently active. IRI: int:isActive.
